title: Collections
empty_description: Create your first collection to start tracking.
error_description: Your collections are safe. The app could not reach its server — check that it is running, then try again.
collection_error_description: Your data is safe. The app could not reach its server — check that it is running, then try again.
reload_error: Could not refresh from the server. These are the collections from the last successful load.
name_blank: Enter a name for the collection.
name_placeholder: e.g. Books, Vinyl Records, Board Games
finite_label: Finite set (a fixed, known number of items)
target_label: Number of items in the set
target_hint: Optional. A whole number from 1 to {{max}} — leave it empty if you do not know it yet.
progress_no_target: Add how many items the set has in Edit collection to see your progress.
field_label_blank: Enter a label for this field.
fields_none: A collection needs at least one field. Add one to continue.
field_options_blank: Add at least one option, separated by commas.
submit_error: Could not create the collection. Check your input and try again.
export_collection_error: The export failed. Please try again.
import_unavailable_image: “{{field}}” is a required image field, and images can’t come from a CSV file, so items can’t be imported into this collection from CSV.
import_file_hint: A UTF-8 CSV file whose first row names its columns, up to 10,000 rows. Write dates as YYYY-MM-DD, separate the choices in a multiselect with semicolons, and separate tags with commas.
import_read_error_too_large: That file is larger than 10 MB. Split it and import each part.
import_read_error_encoding: That file is not UTF-8. Save it from your spreadsheet as “CSV UTF-8” and choose it again.
import_read_error_unreadable: That file could not be read as CSV. Check for a quote that is never closed.
import_read_error_empty: That file has no rows under its header row.
import_read_error_too_many_rows: That file has more than 10,000 rows. Split it and import each part.
import_read_error_too_many_columns: That file has more than 100 columns.
import_columns_hint: Choose the field each column fills. Columns set to “Don’t import” are left out, and fields no column fills are left empty.
import_missing_required: Choose a column for “{{field}}”, which is required.
import_duplicate: “{{target}}” is chosen for more than one column. Choose it once.
import_preview_caption: The first rows to be added
import_issue_extra_cells: more cells than the header row has columns
import_issue_required: empty, but the field is required
import_issue_invalid_rating: not a whole number from 0 to {{max}}
import_issue_invalid_url: not a web address starting with http:// or https://
import_issue_invalid_select: not one of the field’s options
import_issue_invalid_multiselect: holds a choice that is not one of the field’s options
import_none_to_add: No rows can be added yet. Change the column choices, or fix the file and choose it again.
import_error_too_large: That import is too large for the server. Split the file and import each part.
import_error_gone: This collection is no longer here. It may have been moved to the trash.
import_error_changed: The collection’s fields changed. Choose the file again to check it against them.
import_error: The import failed and nothing was added. Please try again.
save_error: Could not save the collection. Check your input and try again.
field_type_locked: Cannot change the type: this collection already has items, and their stored values would not convert.
remove_field_note: Removing a field hides it from every item. The values are kept in your data and stay in a JSON backup, but they are no longer shown, and adding the field back starts it empty.
tags_none: No item carries a tag here yet.
tags_none_matching: No tag in use matches that.
tags_truncated: Showing the 50 most used tags. Find a tag to reach the rest.
tags_load_error: Could not load the tags in use. Check that the app's server is running, then try again.
tags_change_error: Could not change this tag. Your items are as they were — check that the app's server is running, then try again.
tags_remove_prompt_one: Remove “{{tag}}” from {{count}} item? This cannot be undone.
tags_remove_prompt_other: Remove “{{tag}}” from {{count}} items? This cannot be undone.
tags_no_comma: A tag cannot contain a comma.
tags_tidied_one: Made “{{tag}}” the one spelling on {{count}} item
tags_tidied_other: Made “{{tag}}” the one spelling on {{count}} items
tags_trash_from_one: , and from {{count}} item in the trash
tags_trash_from_other: , and from {{count}} items in the trash
tags_trash_on_one: , and on {{count}} item in the trash
tags_trash_on_other: , and on {{count}} items in the trash
